caption: Condition to complete the Forest: Flower
content:
Make flowers bloom on all roads.
Each road separated by empty lots blooms when it is sandwiched between @b{exactly one pair of sprouted stumps}.

content.caption: Failed examples
content: If a road isn't sandwiched between a pair of stumps, the condition isn't met.
If two or more pairs of stumps sandwich the same road, the flowers wilt and the condition isn't met.
